email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV VALDA CREST - Rotterdam, Rijnmond Energy Coal Terminal

The coal berth is occupied. The vessel ahead is expected to complete discharge late on 26 Jan. VALDA CREST is next in line, berthing about 27 Jan 0600 UTC, subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned.

We will advise at once if the line-up changes. Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Maasport Agencies, Rotterdam

result.result:
**Judgement.** Maasport Agencies says VALDA CREST may berth Rotterdam about 27 Jan 0600 UTC — the time is qualified ("about", "subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned"), so it is tentative, not firm, and Maasport will advise if the line-up changes. The current port call ETA is 25 Jan 21:00 UTC, so berthing would slip about 29 hours. Heavy weather (wind up to Beaufort 8, seas to 6.1 m) was expected on the route from 22 Jan evening to 24 Jan, so the Master's safety judgement in the prevailing weather comes before any speed order.

**Speed advice (voyage optimisation service, simulated figures for this demo).** For a berthing time of 27 Jan 0600 UTC: advised speed 8.3 kn, arrival at Rotterdam 27 Jan 04:00 UTC (2 hours before berth), about 31 hours at anchor, and about 38.1 t VLSFO saved versus the base speed of 12.4 kn. The speed plan checks out against the route distance (763.6 nm via Dover) and arrives before the berth.

The operator needs to decide whether to order this reduced speed to the Master. If yes, the following drafts would be prepared for operator approval before anything is sent:

(a) A speed instruction to the Master: steady 8.3 kn to arrive Rotterdam 27 Jan 04:00 UTC, with the caveat that his judgement for the safety of the ship in the weather ahead comes first.

(b) An ETA notice to the agent and receiver roles: check_notices says an ETA notice is due now — the ETA has moved 31 hours since the last notice (25 Jan 21:00 UTC), exceeding the CP limit of 12 hours. New ETA: Rotterdam 27 Jan 04:00 UTC.

(c) A voyage management system entry: port call ETA updated to 27 Jan 04:00 UTC for Rotterdam.

Recommend that nothing be sent until the operator answers.
